title: Gender Gaps in the Urban Wage Premium
title_zh: DP19592 城市工资溢价中的性别差距
authors: Kenza Elass, Cecilia García-Peñalosa, Christian Schluter, Kenza Elass; Cecilia García-Peñalosa; Christian Schluter
official: 官方在线 2024-10-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We examine the economic geography of gender wage gaps to understand the role that location plays in gender earning differences. Using panelised administrative data for the universe of French workers, our findings indicate that women benefit relatively more from density than men, with an urban wage premium (return to urban density) 48% higher than for men. We identify a number of factors that explain this gap, with a large share being explained by the structure of the local labour market, notably, the extent of occupational segregation. Another important factor is commuting patterns, while childcare availability plays only a moderate role.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了性别工资差距的经济地理学，以理解地理位置在性别收入差异中的作用。利用法国全体劳动者的面板化行政数据，研究结果表明，女性从城市密度中获得的相对收益高于男性，其城市工资溢价（城市密度的回报率）比男性高出48%。我们识别出若干解释这一差距的因素，其中很大一部分归因于当地劳动力市场的结构，尤其是职业隔离的程度。另一个重要因素是通勤模式，而儿童保育的可获得性仅起到中等程度的作用。

title: Firm Heterogeneity, Market Power and Macroeconomic Fragility
title_zh: 企业异质性、市场势力与宏观经济脆弱性
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study how firm heterogeneity and market power affect macroeconomic fragility, defined as the probability of long slumps. We propose a theory where the positive interaction between firm entry, competition, and factor supply can give rise to multiple steady-states. We show that when firms are highly heterogeneous in terms of productivities, even small temporary shocks can trigger firm exit and make the economy spiral into a competition-driven poverty trap. We calibrate our model to incorporate the well-documented trends on rising firm heterogeneity in the US economy, and show that they significantly increase the likelihood and length of slow recoveries.
abstract_zh: 本文研究企业异质性与市场势力如何影响宏观经济脆弱性，即长期衰退的概率。我们提出一个理论，其中企业进入、竞争与要素供给之间的正向互动可能导致多重稳态。研究表明，当企业在生产率方面高度异质时，即使是微小的暂时性冲击也可能引发企业退出，并使经济陷入竞争驱动的贫困陷阱。我们通过校准模型纳入美国经济中企业异质性上升的已有趋势，并证明这些趋势显著增加了缓慢复苏的可能性与持续时间。

title: Digitalization and Credit Markets: Evidence from eInvoicing
title_zh: 数字化与信贷市场：来自电子发票的证据
authors: David Martinez-Miera, Alejandro Casado, Marco Giometti, Jose Gutierrez, Alexandra Matyunina, Tammaro Terracciano, David Martinez-Miera; Alejandro Casado; Marco Giometti; Jose Gutierrez; Alexandra Matyunina; Tammaro Terracciano
official: 官方在线 2026-07-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We document the effects of electronic invoicing (eInvoicing) on credit markets. By making invoices more standardized, verifiable, and harder to falsify, eInvoicing changes lenders’ information sets, facilitating invoice-based financing and credit risk assessment. We exploit a regional eInvoicing mandate and administrative credit data using a difference-in-differences design to provide three main insights. First, credit reallocates toward firms already relying on invoice-based credit (“invoice firms”) and away from non-invoice firms. Second, the cost of (non-)invoice credit falls (rises) for (non-)invoice firms, consistent with a supply-driven mechanism. Third, banks’ information production changes: eInvoicing widens (reduces) the dispersion of rates and banks’ risk assessments and improves (worsens) their predictive accuracy for (non-)invoice firms. Overall, eInvoicing reshapes credit market outcomes, with uneven effects across borrowers.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了电子发票对信贷市场的影响。通过使发票更加标准化、可验证且难以伪造，电子发票改变了贷款人的信息集，促进了基于发票的融资和信用风险评估。我们利用地区性电子发票强制政策及行政信贷数据，采用双重差分法得出三项主要发现。第一，信贷资源向已依赖发票信贷的企业（"发票企业"）重新配置，同时从非发票企业流出。第二，发票企业（非发票企业）的（非）发票信贷成本下降（上升），这与供给驱动机制一致。第三，银行的信息生产发生变化：电子发票扩大了（缩小了）利率和银行风险评估的离散程度，并改善（恶化）了对发票企业（非发票企业）的预测准确性。总体而言，电子发票重塑了信贷市场格局，但对不同借款人的影响存在差异。

title: Labor Market Consequences of Generative AI: Early Evidence from Norway
title_zh: 生成式人工智能对劳动力市场的影响：来自挪威的早期证据
official: 官方在线 2022-01-01 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Does Generative AI displace early-career workers? We provide population-wide evidence from Norwegian administrative registers, 2015 through March 2025, exploiting the November 2022 release of ChatGPT as an availability shock. Using the within-firm composition difference-in-differences employed in recent work, supplemented with a synthetic difference-in-differences at the occupation level and a firm-level shift-share design, we find no robust evidence of employment displacement among young workers in highly AI-exposed occupations, nor any robust response across other age cohorts or on incumbent labor-market outcomes. While estimated coefficients for young workers are negative, in line with the existing literature, they are small and statistically insignificant. A backdating exercise on the synthetic difference-in-differences yields larger absolute estimates than the actual treatment date across most age bands. This suggests the apparent post-2022 decline reflects, at least in part, pre-existing secular trends rather than a clean AI-period break.
abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能是否取代了早期职业工作者？我们利用挪威行政登记数据（2015年至2025年3月）提供全人口层面的证据，以2022年11月ChatGPT的发布作为可得性冲击。采用近期研究中使用的企业内构成双重差分法，辅以职业层面的合成双重差分法和企业层面的份额转移设计，我们未发现年轻工作者在高人工智能暴露职业中存在就业替代的稳健证据，也未发现其他年龄群体或现有劳动力市场结果存在稳健反应。尽管年轻工作者的估计系数为负，与现有文献一致，但系数较小且统计上不显著。对合成双重差分法进行回溯检验发现，在大多数年龄段中，实际处理日期之前的绝对估计值大于实际处理日期之后的估计值。这表明2022年后的表面下降至少部分反映了既有的长期趋势，而非人工智能时期的明确结构性断裂。

title: A Tale of Demand and Supply for Central Bank Reserves
title_zh: 中央银行准备金需求与供给的故事
authors: Sriya Anbil, Sebastian Infante, Zeynep Senyuz
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: In an ample-reserves framework, administered rates anchor money markets but suppress information from unsecured interbank trading. We recover that information by isolating the small interbank segment of the federal funds market. Using high-frequency bank-level data, we employ deposit shocks as an instrument for bank borrowing demand. Our analysis reveals that non-bank lenders, such as Federal Home Loan Banks, supply funds elastically, whereas bank lenders exhibit price inelasticity, which intensifies as their reserve balances decline, particularly for bankers’ banks. This interbank segment highlights distributional frictions in the federal funds market that emerge well before aggregate reserves become scarce and provides new evidence on monetary policy transmission in an ample-reserves regime.
abstract_zh: 在充足准备金框架下，管理利率锚定货币市场，但抑制了无担保银行间交易的信息。我们通过分离联邦基金市场中规模较小的银行间板块来恢复这些信息。利用高频银行层面数据，我们将存款冲击作为银行借款需求的工具变量。分析表明，非银行贷方（如联邦住房贷款银行）具有弹性资金供给，而银行贷方则表现出价格缺乏弹性，且随着其准备金余额下降（尤其是对银行家银行而言）这种缺乏弹性会加剧。这一银行间板块凸显了在总准备金变得稀缺之前就已出现的联邦基金市场分配摩擦，并为充足准备金制度下的货币政策传导提供了新证据。
